_published_faq.name: How do I add Fireflies to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fireflies to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.fireflies.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Fireflies MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Fireflies scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fireflies MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies provides these MCP tools: get_user, get_transcript, and get_transcripts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fireflies?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fireflies in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Fireflies requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Fireflies failing MCP readiness checks?
